old_caption: The video captures a close-up view of a pot of water boiling on a gas stove. The pot is metallic and sits atop one of the burners, which is lit with a blue flame. As the water boils vigorously, creating a dynamic scene with bubbles rising to the surface, a hand enters the frame holding a digital thermometer labeled "INKBIRD." The thermometer is inserted into the boiling water, and the temperature reading fluctuates slightly, showing values such as 85.9°C, 95.4°C, and 98.6°C. The background remains consistent throughout the video, focusing solely on the pot and the thermometer, emphasizing the boiling process and the temperature readings. There are no other significant objects or characters present in the scene, and the camera maintains a steady position, ensuring clear visibility of the boiling water and the thermometer's readings.

caption: The video captures a close, mostly fixed view of a metal saucepan sitting on a gas-stove burner, its blue flame steady beneath a pot of vigorously boiling water. A person's right hand holds an INKBIRD digital thermometer over the rim, the metal probe dipped into the churning liquid, so the measurement is already underway as the clip opens. The LCD's digits climb through the excerpt, stepping from a transitional reading up through values around 85.9, then 95.4, then 98.6, and finally settling near 99.7 degrees Celsius. Throughout, bubbles form, rise, and burst at the surface while steam drifts upward, and the hand and thermometer remain in essentially the same position with only slight tremor. The pot, burner grates, and surrounding stove keep their relative positions, so the visible motion comes mainly from the changing temperature display and the restless boiling water rather than any camera travel.
